pages.text: Open the clipboard in hand or at the writing desk. Name the list and add tasks. Each page has nine tasks, and a clipboard can hold up to 50 pages. Click a task’s mark to cycle between blank, checked, and crossed.
Any vanilla wooden pressure plate works.

pages.title: Wall Checklist
pages.text: Sneak-right-click a wall with the clipboard to hang it. Click a checkbox on the front of the board to mark a task. Click its page controls to turn pages. Sneak-right-click with an empty hand to take it down with all its data.
